title: 100-Mode Grid with 16-Block ResNet + Tanh
intuition: Combines a 16-block residual generator with saturating `tanh` activations on `grid100`, testing whether deep residual spectral conditioning also prevents tanh rail saturation (max_saturated_fraction gate).
failure_mode: Aggressive spectral step sizes push residual branches into tanh saturation, clipping outer modes of the 100-mode grid and failing the saturation fraction check.
protocol_notes: Tier-4 held benchmark and Four Laws Adherence Law 4 anchor with explicit `max_saturated_fraction` gate.
